dx_raw:
DIAGNOSIS: Functional neurological symptom disorder (functional neurological disorder presenting as left upper-limb ataxia with subjective sensory symptoms, no objective sensory deficit, and otherwise normal neurological examination)

1. Structural cerebellar lesion (e.g., posterior fossa tumour or cavernoma) involving the right cerebellar hemisphere
2. Multiple sclerosis with a right cerebellar or cervical cord lesion
3. Cervical cord or foramen magnum lesion (e.g., Chiari malformation or syrinx) causing unilateral upper-limb incoordination
